purpose: Challenge the selected wick-balance mechanism against every nearby frozen family before any Campaign048 value is computed.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_two_sided_wick_absorption_balance_240m
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Balanced rejection of both intraminute extremes is consistent with continuous two-sided liquidity absorption rather than one-sided pressure, potentially leaving a more resilient completed-session state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: Across exactly 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, define lower wick l_i=log(min(open_i,close_i)/low_i) and upper wick u_i=log(high_i/max(open_i,close_i)). Pool L=sum(l_i) and U=sum(u_i) and return 2*min(L,U)/(L+U).
selected_mechanism.support_rule: All 240 bars must be finite, positive, and exactly ordered low<=min(open,close)<=max(open,close)<=high; require at least 120 bars with high>low.
selected_mechanism.zero_semantics: Retain exact-zero upper and lower wicks; require finite L+U>0.

overlap_challenges.reason: Body efficiency allocates range to absolute open-close body. Campaign048 uses only residual upper/lower wick distances and scores their balance; total wick share is explicitly excluded.
Close-location pressure is directional around close and ignores open. Campaign048 is sign-symmetric, uses both open and close to define body boundaries, and rewards two-sided balance.
Range-frontier balance measures fresh running-session extremes across time. Campaign048 is own-bar geometry and contains no running frontier or record event.
Those factors compare or merge high-low intervals across bars. Campaign048 never compares price intervals across time.
Those mechanisms use total range magnitudes, their distribution, or serial/profile relation. Campaign048 aggregates only upper/lower wick components into one balance statistic.
Those mechanisms use prior-bar boundaries or interbar gaps. Campaign048 uses no transition, gap, breakout, containment, or lag.
Campaign047 uses open/close sequential body-to-next-gap correlation and reads no high/low. Campaign048 uses contemporaneous OHLC wick geometry and no lag or correlation.
Campaign048 uses no volume, amount, VWAP, peer benchmark, disclosure, Candidate49 value, terminal value, fit, filter, or combination.

decision.next_action: Bind this record, append terminal Campaign047 to the inherited 70-factor order, freeze one exact post-admission trial, and run the binding validator before implementation.
